mechanism: Both returned amounts are compared with the rounded requirement after applying the margin.
trigger: A print requires 100 g at a 10% margin.
expectedBehavior: Both response amounts must equal 110 g.
incorrectBehavior: N/A; the change rejects mismatched reservation values.
reproduction: Call acceptsReservation(100, 10, {recordedGrams:110, availableGrams:110}) and expect true; call it with both values set to 1 and expect false.
unacceptableAllegations: Claiming the margin is applied twice.
Claiming valid non-integer grams are silently rounded down.
